questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All woods are roots.

All fruits are roots.

No woods are a fruit.

**Conclusion:**

(I) Some roots are fruits.

(II) All roots are woods.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows
Both conclusion I and II follows

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/348f982b0f11da79622a28648c7ff0060dd4610e466d7b8200b60c592ba2a0d8.png] 

Concept:

1) We have to check the conclusions are 100% match with the statement. If the conclusion is 100% match with the given statement then the conclusion is true. If there is a 1% chance of not following the statement then the conclusion is considered to be false.

2) The possibility case can be considered to be "false" in "definite case".

3) In Possibility case, either "can" or "possible" word must be present.

__Explanation__

Given, 

__Statements:__

All woods are roots.

All fruits are roots.

No woods are a fruit.

__The least possible Venn diagram is as follows,__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/846d6bd31dce348c1b2afbf1f0c41cbf37b30271eac2fd5a4fd1d361377cfbcc.png] 

**__Conclusion__:**

(I) Some roots are fruits - True

__As it is given in the statements that All fruits are roots then some roots will definitely fruits.__

(II) All roots are woods - False

__As it is given in statements that **"No woods are a fruit"** and **"All fruits are roots"** hence all roots can not be woods.__

Hence, the **Only conclusion I follow.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

questions.question:
Select the option that does NOT belong to the given series:

EC, H, HF, N, KI, U
questions.solution:
Given,

EC, H, HF, N, KI, U

The pattern followed here is,

EC = E + C = 5 + 3 = 8

H = 8

So, EC = H

HF = H + F = 8 + 6 = 14

N = 14

So, HF = N

KI = K + I = 11 + 9 = 20

U = 21

Here, KI ≠ U

Hence, **U** does not belong to the group.

questions.question: If ‘#’ means ‘—’, ‘&’ means ‘÷’, ‘@’ means ‘×’, and ‘÷’ means ‘+’, then 15 @ 2 ÷ 900 & 30 # 10 = ?
questions.solution:
**Operator**

 
 
 
#

 
 
 
&

 
 
 
@

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 
–

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
+

 
 
 

 

Given expression, 15 @ 2 ÷ 900 & 30 # 10 = ?

∴ After replacing the operators by their meaning, we get:

15 × 2 + 900 ÷ 30 - 10

= 15 × 2 + 30 - 10

= 30 + 30 - 10 = 50

Hence, the correct answer is** 50.**
